findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.
findings.summary: Signal has significant reference plane gap
findings.suppression_reason: FALSE POSITIVE, same root cause as PS-002/GP-004. In1.Cu is a solid VIN plane and In2.Cu a solid GND plane, each a single fill region under the whole board.

findings.recommendation: Reduce routing density on this layer or move signals to other layers.
findings.summary: Low ground plane fill ratio
findings.suppression_reason: FALSE POSITIVE, verified 2026-09-04. Fill ratio is computed against the user-drawn zone outline (324 mm2), which is much larger than the 18x10 mm board. Filled GND is 115.8 mm2 of a 180 mm2 board with fill_region_count = 1 -- a single contiguous plane, not a sparse one.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J303
findings.description: Connector J303 (Conn_01x01) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J303. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J303

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J401
findings.description: Connector J401 (CONN_01X02) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: J401 appears to be a power-only connector (all pins are power/ground rails). A board-level ferrite bead would saturate at typical power-supply currents. If radiated EMI is a concern on the cable, add a system-level common-mode choke or use shielded cable with chassis termination.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J401

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J201
findings.description: J201 (CONN_02X04) has 1 ground pin(s) for 3 signal pins. Recommended: at least 2 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J201 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on J201

findings.title: Clock /ACCEL_SCK on outer layer
findings.description: Clock net /ACCEL_SCK is 100% routed on outer layers (microstrip). Inner stripline layers provide better shielding from radiation.
findings.recommendation: Route clock signals on inner layers (stripline) when possible.
findings.summary: Clock /ACCEL_SCK on outer layer
findings.suppression_reason: Accepted: a 4-layer 0.4 mm tag routes SPI and the 32.768 kHz clock on outer layers over solid inner planes. Emissions at 10 uA and <=1 MHz SPI are not a compliance risk for an animal-borne tag.

findings.recommendation: Route /clkout away from J303, or add ground guard traces between the clock and connector.
findings.summary: Clock /clkout routed near connector J303
findings.suppression_reason: Cites J301-J304 and J401, which are mounting holes and a battery connector. Clock-near-connector findings against them are noise.

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /ACCEL_MISO
findings.description: Net /ACCEL_MISO has 2 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu. 2 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /ACCEL_MISO
findings.suppression_reason: Stitching-via rule on an 18x10 mm board with 14 GND and 7 VIN stitching vias and solid inner planes. Return-path lengths are millimetres.
